verdict.rationale: Portkey's virtual keys and model catalog explicitly let developers add/store their own provider API keys ('Add a provider, then use @provider-slug/model-name', 'Provider credentials stored securely, never exposed in code'), and the gateway routes traffic through these keys with governance/rate-limit controls layered on top. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the BYO-key flow and no explicit mention of per-key traffic isolation/audit beyond docs claims.
